title: Exact functors carry exact couples and their spectral sequences
statement:
Let $\Phi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be an exact additive functor between abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and let $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ be an exact couple in $\mathcal A$ [def-sp-exact-couple], with spectral sequence $(E_r,d_r)_{r\geq2}$, $E_2=E$. Then:

1. $(\Phi D,\Phi E,\Phi\alpha,\Phi f,\Phi g)$, obtained by applying $\Phi$ to every component $D^{p,q}$, $E^{p,q}$ and every structure map, is an exact couple in $\mathcal B$.
2. Write $(\Phi E)_r$, $d_r^\Phi$ for the pages and differentials of its spectral sequence. There are isomorphisms $\phi_r^{p,q}:\Phi(E_r^{p,q})\xrightarrow{\sim}(\Phi E)_r^{p,q}$ for all $r\geq2$ and $(p,q)$, with $\phi_2=\mathrm{id}$, such that $\phi_r\circ\Phi(d_r)=d_r^\Phi\circ\phi_r$ and $\phi_{r+1}$ is the map induced by $\phi_r$ on cohomology, $\Phi$ commuting with cohomology because it is exact; likewise $\Phi(D_r)\cong(\Phi D)_r$ for the iterated derived couples.
3. If $(D,E)$ satisfies the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence] ($D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$, $E^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$), so does $(\Phi D,\Phi E)$; then, with $A^n=D^{0,n}$ and the finite filtration $F^pA^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to A^n)$ of that theorem [def-sp-filtration], the filtration of $\Phi A^n=(\Phi D)^{0,n}$ given by the theorem for $(\Phi D,\Phi E)$ is $F^p\Phi A^n=\Phi(F^pA^n)$ (as subobjects of $\Phi A^n$), and the isomorphism $(\Phi E)_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^p\Phi A^{p+q}/F^{p+1}\Phi A^{p+q}$ of the theorem is $\Phi$ applied to $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pA^{p+q}/F^{p+1}A^{p+q}$, composed with the isomorphisms $\phi_r$ (for $r$ large) and $\Phi(F^p/F^{p+1})\cong\Phi F^p/\Phi F^{p+1}$.

source.place: Section 12.21 (Spectral sequences: exact couples), Definitions 12.21.1, 12.21.3 and Lemma 12.21.2 (Tags 011Q, 011S, 011R), transported along an exact functor; the transport is not stated there.
